ev.q: Network analysis indicated that 91% of gatherings were associated with fraternity or sorority activities
Among 58 links between gatherings, 42 (72%) were associated with fraternity or sorority activities, 11 (19%) with on-campus dormitories
Forty-eight (5%) persons with COVID-19 had received in-class instruction
The number of cases with reported illness onset on a given day increased and peaked on August 31
Women constitute 54% of university A’s 2020 student body but accounted for 70% of university A’s COVID-19 cases
A network analysis was performed to assess the relationship between participation in university fraternity or sorority activities

methods_quotes.q: These networks were used to infer gatherings by algorithmically partitioning the network into the most densely linked cases
Illness onset was defined as the earliest date of reported symptoms for symptomatic cases
COVID-19 patients were included in the network if they lived on campus, participated in fraternity or sorority activities
